risk_note: Money path, RV2, one call in one file. W10 resolving as paid (PAID_API) now enqueues B2-09t's late_paid_check for an Alipay withdrawal in the same transaction, so a paid_at a person gave on a bill day R2 has finished is still checked against the stored bill rows (go-live gap 25, second half; D10-679). The worker judgement is B2-09t's, unchanged. Refusals, rollbacks (audit, voucher, tax_ytd faults; no verified real name) and replays leave no job; bank card and WeChat get none. The job row's xmin equals the PAID_API event's: the withdrawal UPDATE runs inside a savepoint, so its own xmin is a subtransaction id and is not compared. No migration, no contract change, no frozen test changed: the rewrite of B2-09t's #35 (a 60 second timeout red into an assertion red) was moved out, because a changed test must be red on the old code and #35 is green there by design; it goes in a separate green test-change task.

reviews.note: Codex via codex-run.sh, couli-runs/B2-09u/money-review-r1.json, static, read-only, no findings. Reviewed before the rebase.

spec_test_review.note: Codex wrote the rule tests in 2 attempts: the first compared the withdrawal row's xmin, a subtransaction id under W10's savepoint, so it failed on the correct implementation; the second compares the PAID_API event row. A fresh Claude reviewed (approvals 19), static, r1 pass. Mutations run by the author and reverted: enqueueing for every channel turns #2 red by assertion; enqueueing in a separate transaction turns all 12 red, but through a 500 answer from the route rather than through the xmin assertion.

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
